title: Head of Payment
description:
**Job Summary**

* This role could be based in Singapore and India. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, Please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.
* The Head of Payments Technology is a senior domain technology leader responsible for the development, delivery and reliability of the Bank’s payments ecosystem across assigned business and geographic areas. Reporting to the CIO, Cash, the role is accountable for payment routing, market infrastructure connectivity, clearing rail integration, settlement capabilities, Nostro/Vostro mechanics and emerging digital payment rails within its remit. The role is responsible for executing the Payments technology strategy for the assigned business and/or geographic remit, aligned to the direction set by the CIO Payments.
* Leading a specialised team of domain engineers and business analysts, the role drives the engineering and delivery of complex domestic and cross-border payment flows, ensuring transactions are processed securely, reliably and efficiently while meeting client, regulatory, market infrastructure and operational resilience requirements.
* The role partners across Payments Business, Product, Payment Platforms, Operations, Treasury, Architecture and Engineering to translate business and market priorities into scalable technology solutions, supporting growth, regulatory change, evolving payment infrastructures and increasing client complexity.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy**

* Execute the Payments technology strategy for the assigned business and/or geographic remit, aligned to the direction set by the CIO Payments.
* Deliver the target-state capabilities for payment routing, settlement, clearing connectivity, Nostro/Vostro and funds movement services.
* Establish and execute roadmaps for payment scheme connectivity, ISO 20022, intelligent routing and next-generation settlement capabilities.
* Maintain the stability, resilience and scalability of payment systems and rails against client, scheme and regulatory requirements.
* Drive adoption of real-time payments, APIs, programmable payments, digital assets and other emerging payment capabilities relevant to the remit.

**Business**

* Partner with Business, Product, Treasury and Operations to translate client and market requirements into scalable payment technology solutions.
* Enable business growth through reliable domestic, cross-border and real-time payment capabilities and differentiated client solutions.
* Optimise payment routing, settlement and liquidity outcomes, balancing client experience, resilience, cost and regulatory requirements.
* Support new propositions, market expansion, regulatory change and payment infrastructure transformation.
* Provide senior technology leadership on complex client, payment scheme and market infrastructure requirements.

**Delivery & Engineering**

* Co-lead solution design with the Head of Move Money and own engineering and delivery of complex domestic and cross-border payment flows within the assigned remit.
* Lead engineering implementation of routing, settlement, clearing rail integration, Nostro/Vostro and associated payment capabilities.
* Ensure solutions meet enterprise engineering, architecture, security, resilience and operational-readiness standards.
* Drive standardisation, automation and reuse of payment patterns and integration capabilities while accommodating legitimate market and client requirements.
* Own lifecycle delivery of payment scheme integrations, migrations, upgrades and technology dependencies.

**Processes & Operational Resilience**

* Own engineering and system delivery processes across the assigned Payments Technology remit.
* Ensure payment solutions are engineered for availability, scalability, recoverability and compliance with clearing and settlement requirements.
* Establish robust contingency and fallback capabilities for rail outages, liquidity constraints, network failures and market disruptions.
* Ensure adherence to clearing cut-offs, currency settlement windows and critical payment processing schedules.
* Drive continuous improvement in engineering quality, service stability, automation and operational effectiveness.

**Risk Management**

* Own technology delivery and operational risks across payment systems and services within the assigned remit.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, clearing scheme rules, market infrastructure obligations and enterprise risk standards.
* Maintain strong oversight of routing, settlement, liquidity, third-party and market infrastructure dependencies.
* Embed resilience, recoverability and appropriate controls into payment engineering and delivery.
* Proactively identify, escalate and remediate risks arising from service disruption, technology change, liquidity constraints and market infrastructure dependencies.

**Governance**

* Execute governance frameworks established by the CIO Payments across engineering, clearing connectivity, settlement and routing.
* Act as the engineering and delivery authority for material payment technology changes and market infrastructure integrations within the assigned remit.
* Maintain appropriate oversight of payment networks, market infrastructures, vendors and other critical third-party dependencies.
* Provide transparent reporting to the CIO, Cash on delivery, platform health, resilience, risks and strategic initiatives.
* Maintain strong adherence to enterprise architecture, engineering, risk and control standards.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Lead the organisation in accordance with the Group's Values, Code of Conduct and Conduct Principles.
* Ensure payment technology and services comply with applicable regulatory, market infrastructure and payment scheme requirements.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Financial Crime, Legal and Operations to identify, escalate and remediate regulatory, conduct, sanctions, AML and resilience risks.
* Ensure appropriate controls are embedded across cross-border and domestic payment flows to safeguard payment integrity and client outcomes.
* Foster a strong culture of accountability, transparency, prudent risk-taking and proactive risk management.

**People and Talent**

* Build and lead a global team of payment and distributed systems engineers, domain specialists, and business analysts.
* Create a culture of technical excellence, innovation, client focus and domain leadership.
* Develop deep organizational expertise in payment schemes, settlement mechanisms, liquidity management, market infrastructures and emerging payment technologies.
* Attract, retain and develop highly specialized payment domain talent.
* Establish succession plans for critical engineering and domain leadership roles.
* Coach senior architects and technical leads to become recognised subject matter experts across the industry.
* Foster collaboration across Business, Product, Treasury, Operations, Architecture and Engineering teams.

**Our Ideal Candidate**

* 15+ years of experience in distributed software delivery and API frameworks.
* Strong understanding of client needs and tailoring services to accommodate.
* Expertise in post-payment processing domains: investigations, SWIFT Case Management, billing/revenue engines, and real-time liquidity reporting.
* Proven knowledge of operational risk management, recoverability frameworks, and strict industry clearing schedules.
* Demonstrated leadership managing multi-regional engineering and operational technology teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Finance/Banking Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Payments-specific industry qualifications or certifications covering payment schemes, SWIFT, ISO 20022, transaction banking or market infrastructures are advantageous.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex payments technology, engineering and transformation at scale

**Languages**

* Business Communication: Advanced / Fluent, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to influence senior executives, technical leaders, business stakeholders and globally distributed teams.

**Role Specific Technical Competencies**

* Global & Domestic Payments Architecture
* Payment Routing & Orchestration
* Clearing & Settlement Schemes (FEDWIRE, CHIPS, TARGET2, CHAPS, FAST, NPP, RTGS etc.)
* ISO 20022 & SWIFT Ecosystem
* Nostro / Vostro & Liquidity Flows
* Cross-Border Payments Architecture
* Market Infrastructure Integration
* Software Engineering
* Distributed Systems Architecture

**Other Skills**

* Action Oriented
* Collaborates
* Customer Focus
* Courage
* Instils Trust
* Nimble Learning
* Decision Quality
* Develops Talent
* Drives Vision & Purpose
* Gives Clarity and Guidance
* Manages Ambiguity
* Strategic Mindset

**Motivations**

* Client & business impact: Energised by translating complex client, business and market needs into reliable, scalable payment solutions.
* Complex problem solving: Thrives on solving challenging payment routing, settlement, liquidity and market infrastructure problems.
* Engineering excellence: Driven to improve reliability, resilience, scalability and quality across mission-critical payment services.
* Transformation & innovation: Motivated by modernising payment capabilities and adopting real-time, digital and emerging payment technologies.
* End-to-end ownership: Enjoys taking accountability from solution design through engineering, delivery and operational performance.
* Global collaboration: Energised by working across business lines, markets and functions to deliver common outcomes while addressing local requirements.
* Building specialist talent: Passionate about developing high-performing teams and deep payment domain and engineering expertise.

title: Senior People Growth & Experience Expert
description:

Für die Sicherheit von Menschen und der Gesellschaft fordern wir uns jeden Tag aufs Neue heraus. Wir leben Technologie, wir streben nach professioneller Exzellenz, wir setzen Zeichen. Wir nehmen die Zukunft in die Hand. Wir sind die TÜV SÜD Gruppe.
  
  
Wir suchen einen
**Senior People Growth & Experience Expert**
, der die Einführung des Performance- und Entwicklungsprozesses in SuccessFactors vorantreibt. Diese Position verbindet
**strategisches Denken mit operativer Umsetzungsverantwortung**

**Stakeholder-Management & regionale Abstimmung**

**Deployment & Rollout**

* Koordination globaler Rollout-Aktivitäten und Konsolidierung regionaler Anforderungen und Rückmeldungen

**Prozess- & Datenverantwortung**

**Entscheidungsbefugnis**

* Treffen operativer Entscheidungen innerhalb des Workstreams
* Bewertung von Änderungsanforderungen und Abgabe von Empfehlungen im Einklang mit globalen Standards und rechtlichen Anforderungen
* Steuerung und Überwachung externer Partner zur Sicherstellung von Qualität und abgestimmter Umsetzung

**Anforderungen**

* Fundierte Erfahrung in digitaler Transformation im HR-/People-Bereich, Prozessdesign oder der Implementierung groß angelegter Systeme (z. B. SAP SuccessFactors)
* Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung funktionsübergreifender oder globaler Projektteams

title: Center Head
description:
**Designation: Centre Head**

**Department: Client Experience and Operations**

The Centre Manager is responsible for the end-to-end performance of the center — client experience, operational excellence, service delivery, vendor management, and profitability.

**1. Client Experience & Relationship Management**

* Serves as the primary point of contact for all clients in the center.
* Conducts regular client meetings to gather feedback and drive satisfaction.
* Manages the entire client lifecycle: move-in, onboarding, experience, engagement, move-out.
* Resolves escalations within committed SLAs and proactively tracks dissatisfaction drivers.
* Drives adoption of Smartworks tech platforms (C-SPOC, ticketing, etc.).
* Supports renewal coordination by highlighting early risks, preparing feedback insights, and partnering with Regional/City leads.

**2. Operations Excellence & Service Delivery**

* Ensures centre readiness through daily rounds across reception, cafeteria, pantry, washrooms, and client areas.
* Monitors housekeeping, security, pantry, and engineering teams to maintain SLA and quality standards.
* Oversees ticket resolution, prevents recurrence, and ensures timely closure.
* Coordinates with teams to ensure smooth execution of soft and hard services.
* Ensures compliance with cleaning schedules, deep cleaning, and pantry/café standards.

**3. P&L, Revenue & Financial Hygiene**

* Owns centre-level profitability, cost control, and revenue leakage management.
* Tracks and drives VAS and supplementary revenue opportunities (meals, events, services, add-ons).
* Manages consumables, electricity usage, and R&M expenses within budget.
* Ensures timely collections by coordinating with clients and the Finance team.
* Prevents revenue leakage through accurate billing, supplementary invoicing, and documentation.

**4. Infrastructure, Equipment & Vendor Management**

* Ensures uptime and functioning of HVAC, LCM, lighting, FR/VMS systems, and other critical equipment.
* Drives AMC & PPM schedules with adherence and escalates vendor delays.
* Oversees vendor performance across housekeeping, security, pantry, pest control, and engineering.
* Tracks all POs and ensures timely bill submission and approval.
* Maintains standardization across centre equipment, lighting, signage, and hygiene norms.

**5. Compliance, Reporting & Centre Governance**

* Submits daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and management reports accurately and on time.
* Shares incident reports within defined timelines and ensures corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensures centre-level compliance (fire safety, statutory checks, building licenses).
* Escalates builder-related issues and follows up until closure.

**6. People Leadership & Capability Building**

* Manages center staff and deployed manpower, ensuring discipline, grooming, performance, and attendance.
* Conducts shift briefings and coaches’ teams on service excellence and Smartworks standards.
* Partners on learning and development initiatives for centre teams.
* Fosters a collaborative, high-performance culture aligned with Smartworks values.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Education**

**Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline**

* **MBA/PGDM in Operations, Facility Management, or Business Management would be an added advantage**

**Experience**

* 12–15 years of experience in centre management, facility operations, hospitality, or client-facing environments.
* Strong experience in people and vendor management.
* Exposure to commercial buildings, MEP basics, client servicing, and operational governance.

**Skills**

* Strong communication and relationship management
* Operational excellence mindset
* Analytical and data-driven decision making
* Crisis management and escalation handling
* Coordination with cross-functional teams

title: Diploma Civil Engineer
company: Maa Tara Marine & Shipyard pvt Ltd
description:
**Company Description**
Maa Tara Marine & Shipyard Pvt. Ltd. operates in the marine and shipyard sector, focusing on the construction, repair, and maintenance of vessels and related infrastructure. The company supports projects that require robust civil engineering input, including dock structures, waterfront facilities, and associated utilities. Team members collaborate closely with technical and operations staff to deliver safe, reliable, and cost-effective solutions. The organization values practical problem-solving, adherence to safety standards, and efficient execution of site-based projects.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Diploma Civil Engineer role based in Namkhana. The role involves assisting in the design and execution of civil works for marine and shipyard projects, including foundations, dock structures, and site infrastructure. Daily responsibilities include preparing and reviewing drawings, supporting planning and scheduling of civil works, coordinating with contractors and site teams, and monitoring progress against project timelines. The Diploma Civil Engineer will conduct site inspections, ensure compliance with safety and quality standards, maintain documentation of work done, and support stormwater management and drainage solutions within the facility. The role also requires close collaboration with senior engineers and project managers to address technical issues and implement corrective actions when needed.

**Qualifications**

* Civil engineering design skills, including basic structural and infrastructure design for marine or industrial environments.
* Knowledge of core civil engineering principles and practices applicable to shipyard and waterfront projects.
* Ability to plan and coordinate civil works, including scheduling, resource allocation, and site coordination.
* Understanding of stormwater management, drainage systems, and related environmental considerations.
* Diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized institution.
* Experience in site supervision or construction execution, preferably in marine, industrial, or infrastructure projects.
* Familiarity with engineering drawings, basic CAD tools, and construction documentation.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and commitment to safety and quality standards.
* Ability to work on-site in Namkhana, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and communicate clearly with stakeholders.

title: Assistant General Manager
description:
**Assistant General Manager – Shuttle Operations**
**LAZ Airport Services | Full-Time | Leadership**
**Lead Operations. Develop Leaders. Drive the Future of Transportation.**
At LAZ Parking, our people are the foundation of our success. As the Assistant General Manager (AGM) of Shuttle Operations, you will play a critical leadership role in supporting one of the region's largest transportation operations.
  
  
This position partners with the General Manager to oversee operational performance, employee engagement, safety, financial results, and customer satisfaction across a complex shuttle transportation environment. You will lead managers, supervisors, and frontline employees while driving operational excellence and ensuring a safe, reliable, and customer-focused transportation experience.
  
  
Whether you are looking to expand your transportation leadership experience, strengthen your operational expertise, or take the next step toward executive-level leadership, LAZ Parking offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day.
  
  
**Why Join LAZ?**

* Senior leadership opportunity within a growing national organization
* Opportunity to influence business strategy and operational performance
* Exposure to large-scale transportation and airport operations
* Career growth and advancement opportunities
* Collaborative, people-first leadership culture
* Opportunity to develop future leaders and strengthen organizational talent
* Dynamic environment where no two days are the same
* PayActiv - access earned wages before payday
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Health coaching and wellness resources
* Employee recognition and development programs

**Full-Time Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Short-Term Disability Coverage
* Long-Term Disability Coverage
* Life Insurance Options

**About LAZ Parking**
LAZ Parking is one of the largest and fastest-growing parking and transportation management companies in the country. Our transportation operations help move millions of passengers annually through airport, commercial, and shuttle transportation services.
  
  
Our success is built on operational excellence, customer service, strong partnerships, and investing in our people. We believe in promoting from within, developing future leaders, and creating opportunities for employees to build long-term careers.
  
  
**At LAZ, parking is our industry, but people are our passion.**
**Schedule & Work Environment**
This position supports a large-scale transportation operation that functions seven days a week and may require schedule flexibility, including mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, emergency response situations, and operationally critical events.
  
  
The Assistant General Manager regularly works throughout transportation facilities, maintenance areas, operational offices, airport environments, and customer-facing locations while interacting with employees, stakeholders, clients, and regulatory agencies.
  
  
**The Spirit of the Position**
As an Assistant General Manager, you are a strategic leader, operational expert, and people developer.
  
  
You understand that successful transportation operations require strong leadership, disciplined execution, exceptional customer service, and an unwavering commitment to safety. Through your leadership, business acumen, and operational expertise, you help create an environment where employees can perform at their best while ensuring the organization delivers outstanding service, financial results, and operational performance.
  
  
You bring professionalism, accountability, innovation, and a solutions-oriented mindset to every challenge.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Strategic Leadership**

* Partner with the General Manager to develop and execute operational and business strategies.
* Identify opportunities for growth, service enhancement, and operational improvement.
* Develop and measure key performance indicators (KPIs) related to service, safety, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Support organizational change initiatives and operational transformation efforts.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives designed to enhance efficiency and service delivery.

**Operational Leadership**

* Oversee daily shuttle transportation operations, including fleet utilization, route management, staffing, and resource allocation.
* Analyze operational performance data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Develop contingency and recovery plans to address operational disruptions.
* Ensure transportation services are delivered safely, efficiently, and consistently.
* Support implementation of technology solutions and operational best practices.
* Drive operational excellence through performance measurement, accountability, and process improvement.

**People Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop managers, supervisors, and frontline employees.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, inclusion, and service excellence.
* Support succession planning and leadership development initiatives.
* Conduct performance evaluations, coaching conversations, and talent development activities.
* Promote employee engagement, retention, and workforce development programs.
* Build high-performing teams focused on achieving organizational goals.

**Safety, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure compliance with all applicable DOT, OSHA, federal, state, local, airport, and company regulations.
* Lead safety initiatives and reinforce a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
* Support audits, inspections, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments.
* Identify operational risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Maintain accurate records, documentation, and compliance reporting.
* Support incident investigations and corrective action efforts when necessary.

**Customer Experience & Stakeholder Relations**

* Champion a customer-first culture that promotes exceptional service delivery.
* Support the development of customer experience initiatives and service enhancements.
* Serve as a key partner to clients, airport stakeholders, vendors, government agencies, and community partners.
* Assist with escalated customer concerns and service recovery efforts.
* Build and maintain strong relationships that support long-term operational success.

**Financial & Administrative Leadership**

* Assist with budget development, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Monitor labor, operational, maintenance, and administrative expenses.
* Analyze financial and operational performance metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency while maintaining service standards.
* Support revenue growth, cost management, and profitability objectives.
* Oversee vendor relationships and support procurement activities when necessary.

**Team & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with the General Manager to align operational objectives with organizational strategy.
* Support market growth, new business opportunities, transitions, and special projects.
* Promote LAZ Parking's mission, values, and culture throughout the operation.
* Drive innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Perform other duties and leadership responsibilities as assigned.

**Who You Are**
**Strategic Thinker**
You can translate organizational goals into actionable plans and measurable results.
  
  
**Operational Leader**
You understand complex transportation operations and can balance efficiency, service, safety, and financial performance.
  
  
**People Developer**
You enjoy coaching leaders, developing talent, and building high-performing teams.
  
  
**Business-Minded**
You understand financial performance, operational metrics, budgeting, and long-term business sustainability.
  
  
**Collaborative Communicator**
You build strong relationships across all levels of an organization and with external stakeholders.
  
  
**Customer Advocate**
You are passionate about delivering exceptional service and creating positive customer experiences.
  
  
**Qualifications Required**

* Valid driver's license and ability to maintain company-approved driving qualifications and motor vehicle record (MVR) standards.
* Minimum of 3 years of progressive leadership experience in transportation, logistics, shuttle operations, parking operations, or a related industry.
* Minimum of 3 years of leadership experience managing supervisors, managers, or large operational teams.
* Strong knowledge of transportation operations, fleet management, safety programs, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience managing operational performance metrics and business objectives.
* Excellent communication, leadership, coaching, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and operational reporting systems.

**Preferred**

* Commercial Driver's License (CDL).
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Transportation Management, Logistics, or a related field.
* Airport transportation or shuttle operations experience.
* Experience managing large-scale or multi-site transportation operations.
* Experience supporting collective bargaining agreements or unionized workforces.
* Experience with fleet management systems, transportation technologies, and data analytics tools.
* Experience leading organizational change and operational transformation initiatives.

**Physical Requirements**
**This Position Requires The Ability To**

* Work both indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Stand and walk for extended periods.
* Travel throughout transportation facilities, operational locations, and airport environments.
* Lift, push, and pull up to 25 pounds.
* Bend, stoop, squat, and move frequently throughout the workday.
* Safely enter and exit transportation vehicles when operational support is required.

title: Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Pioneer Packaging Industries Pvt. Ltd. is one of India’s leading providers of comprehensive packaging solutions for primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging. The company has built a strong reputation as a dynamic and progressive industry player, supported by best-in-class machinery and equipment. Pioneer specializes in corrugated boxes, duplex boxes, labels, shrink sleeves, mono-cartons, and core and angle protectors, serving diverse customer needs. With an annual capacity of 60,000 metric tonnes, it operates one of the largest corrugation setups in India. The organization is committed to uncompromising quality, reliability, and just-in-time service for its customers.
  
**Role Description**
The Production Manager will oversee day-to-day manufacturing operations at the Howrah facility, ensuring that production targets are met safely, efficiently, and in line with quality standards. This is a full-time, on-site role responsible for planning and scheduling production, managing shop-floor teams, and coordinating with procurement, maintenance, and quality control to maintain smooth workflows. The role involves monitoring machine performance, optimizing resource utilization, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives in line with company objectives. The Production Manager will track key performance metrics, resolve operational issues, and ensure adherence to safety, regulatory, and customer requirements. The role also includes training and guiding production staff, supporting audits, and contributing to strategic decisions on capacity and process enhancements.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong production management skills, including planning, scheduling, and resource allocation in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in packaging or corrugation industry operations, with understanding of machinery, materials, and workflow optimization.
* Knowledge of quality management practices, including process control, defect reduction, and compliance with industry standards.
* Proficiency in leadership and people management, including team supervision, performance monitoring, and conflict resolution.
* Ability to analyze production data, use basic ERP or manufacturing software, and implement cost- and time-saving improvements.
* Sound awareness of workplace safety norms and regulatory requirements within an industrial setting.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Prior experience as a Production Manager or in a similar supervisory role, preferably in packaging or related manufacturing sectors.
* Strong communication and coordination skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

title: Assistant Manager - SC Agro
description:
**Overview**
Responsible for driving Contract Farming (CF) operations across the Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram geography to ensure sustainable procurement of quality potatoes for Lay's and Uncle chips. The role is accountable for expanding the farmer base, strengthening procurement networks, managing storage operations, and ensuring uninterrupted supplies to manufacturing plants while building strategic partnerships with farmers, aggregators, cold storages, government agencies, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Contract Farming Development
* Lead the expansion and execution of Contract Farming programs across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Identify and develop new potato-growing clusters, multiplication pockets, and farmer networks to increase program penetration and ensure long-term supply sustainability.
* Drive seed sales, farmer enrolment, and adoption of recommended agronomic practices (POP) through regular field engagement.
* Ensure timely seed distribution, crop monitoring, and technical advisory to achieve quality and productivity targets.
* Strengthen relationships with farmers, aggregators, FPOs, cooperatives, and channel partners to improve farmer retention and program scalability.
* Procurement & Supply Assurance
* Own regional procurement targets for both Contract Farming (CF) and Non-Contract Farming (NCF) potatoes within approved commercial and quality specifications.
* Ensure uninterrupted month-wise and season-wise supply of potatoes from Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram to manufacturing plants.
* Monitor crop quality parameters including TPoD, solids, reducing sugars, and chip-grade specifications.
* Develop market intelligence on crop acreage, arrivals, pricing trends, competitor activities, and procurement opportunities to support commercial decision-making.
* Drive chip-grade procurement programs while ensuring quality compliance and minimizing pilferage.
* Cold Storage & Inventory Management
* Identify, onboard, and manage strategic cold storage partners across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Lead long-storage planning, inventory monitoring, quality management, and phased evacuation to ensure uninterrupted plant supplies throughout the storage season.
* Work closely with storage operators, transport partners, and manufacturing teams to optimize inventory utilization and minimize storage losses.
* Stakeholder & Government Engagement
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Agriculture and Horticulture Departments, Mandi Boards, district administration, and other government agencies across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Partner with FPOs, cooperatives, research institutions, and local organizations to strengthen farmer engagement and expand Contract Farming initiatives.
* Organize farmer meetings, field demonstrations, extension programs, and government-led initiatives to enhance program visibility and adoption.
* Operational Excellence & Compliance
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procurement processes, statutory requirements, and documentation standards.
* Oversee seed sale documentation, procurement records, mandi tax compliance, transportation documentation, and audit readiness.
* Establish and monitor field quality laboratories, cook tests, and procurement quality protocols.
* Promote adoption of digital agriculture tools, satellite-based crop monitoring, precision farming, and data-driven decision-making.
* Ensure operational discipline among aggregators, transporters, cold storage partners, and suppliers.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead and develop the regional Agro team through coaching, mentoring, and technical capability building.
* Support implementation of an effective extension model to strengthen farmer connect and improve field execution.
* Foster a high-performance culture through structured reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Strategic & Sustainability Initiatives
* Drive sustainability initiatives including Sustainable farming practices (SFP), regenerative agriculture, and other resource-efficient farming practices across the region.
* Support R&D initiatives involving new potato varieties, agronomic practices, crop protection molecules, and field demonstrations.

**Qualifications**
Experience & Qualifications
  
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in agriculture (B.Sc. Agriculture) is preferable.
* MBA/Postgraduate qualification in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Marketing, or Supply Chain is preferred.

**Experience**

* 6–8 years of experience in Contract Farming, agricultural procurement, agri-input sales, or agri-supply chain management.
* Strong experience working with potato farming ecosystems, cold storage operations, and farmer engagement in North Bengal, Bihar, or similar geographies.
* Demonstrated ability to manage government stakeholders, FPOs, traders, transporters, and cold storage partners.
* Proven leadership skills with experience in leading field teams and driving regional business outcomes.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Contract Farming Development
* Farmer & Aggregator Relationship Management
* Potato Procurement & Market Intelligence
* Cold Storage & Inventory Management
* Commercial Negotiation
* Government & Institutional Liaison
* Supply Chain Planning & Execution
* Team Leadership & Capability Development
* Data Analytics & Digital Agriculture
* Sustainability & Regenerative Agriculture

Problem Solving & Execution Excellence

title: Manager Business Consulting - IT
description:

Team
  
  

Making an impact.

Winning in your role.

Be Linde. Be Limitless.

title: Production Development Engineer II
description:

 Wellspect Healthcare is a leading global provider of innovative medical devices that help people suffering from urinary retention or chronic constipation. More than 1,000 employees around the world are dedicated to making a difference to people who need our products and services. Wellspect is one of the worlds’ leading manufacturers of intermittent urinary catheters, with LoFric® as the most known brand. As a help to those with chronic or severe constipation Wellspect has developed what likely is the world’s most advanced irrigation system, Navina™, combining a high degree of user convenience, clinical effectiveness and connectivity into one smart system. Wellspect strives to become climate neutral and leave the smallest possible environmental footprint.
   

  

 The company, with headquarters in Mölndal, Sweden, is present in more than 30 countries, and part of Dentsply Sirona, the worlds´ largest manufacturer of professional dental technologies. The company’s shares are listed in the United States on NASDAQ under the symbol XRAY. Visit www.wellspect.com and www.dentsplysirona.com for more information.
   

  

**Production Development Engineer \- Mechanical Design Engineer**
 Join our Production Development team and continue shaping medical device production of tomorrow.
   

  

 Wellspect is continuing to step up the pace in product and production development. We are now offering a position as a Production Development Engineer with focus on Mechanical Design.
   

  

 At Wellspect, we are proud to have an in\-house, highly automated medical device production with interconnected chemical processes, multiple transport systems and packaging machines. We have strict requirements on material traceability and in\-line quality control; an area where we apply Big Data principles and develop machine learning. As a Production Development Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of new and improved production processes as well as ensuring compliance with existing production equipment, with a strong focus on mechanical design.
   

  

**Your Key Accountabilities Are**
* Lead or participate in equipment investment projects all the way from concept, via risk\- and requirements handling, testing and validation to commissioning and handover.
* Participate in cross\-functional project teams, where you will collaborate with both external equipment suppliers and internal stakeholders/departments to find efficient production solutions with Design for Manufacturing as a guiding principle.
* Manage and participate hands\-on in installation, start\-up/commissioning, testing/verification activities in our cleanroom production in Mölndal.
* Lead or participate in improvement projects both related to ongoing production but also to the ways of working within production development.
* Develop documentation in compliance with Wellspect’s quality management system built on regulatory requirements from European medical device and FDA quality systems regulations.
* Establish and maintain working relationships with suppliers including evaluations and supplier visits.
* Perform mechanical design and create 2D/3D drawings and participate during building of custom designed equipment.


**Who You Are**
 You are a positive and driven team player with strong communication skills. You enjoy collaborating and are motivated by working together with highly skilled and committed colleagues. You are open to challenges and appreciate a role where your contribution makes a real difference every day.
   

  

**We believe you have**
* An academic background, preferably in mechanical engineering or equivalent with experience from production development
* Experience of mechanical design and building custom design equipment
* Strong knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, materials science, and manufacturing processes
* CAD Software Skills: Proficiency in CAD software, AutoCAD Inventor
* Knowledge of automated manufacturing process development, preferably from food/life science or other regulated industry
* Some project management experience
* Experience working with technical specifications and external equipment suppliers
* Knowledge of Lean production and Design for Manufacturing principles
* Experience from qualification/testing/process validation, preferably within life science or other regulated industry
* An interest in and understanding of automation technology including Industry 4\.0 principles
* Some experience with data collection and predictive analysis in a production environment
* Documentation and communication skills, in English as well as in Swedish
